pages.text: Simply Swords adds 42 unique named weapons. In IridescentCraft, all 42 are boss-drop-only.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Simply Swords weapons are the best weapons available. Every unique is assigned to a specific boss with a specific drop chance. They are trophies as much as they are tools.$(br2)$(bold)Weapon types:$(/bold) Greatswords, Longswords, Katanas, Spears, Staffs, Warglaives, Scythes, Sabres, and more.

$(bold)How to get them:$(/bold) Kill the matching boss. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon). There are no other sources.$(br2)$(bold)Enchanting compatibility:$(/bold) All Simply Swords uniques are fully compatible with Apotheosis enchanting and affix reforging. A unique weapon with Legendary affixes and max enchants is the endgame weapon ceiling.
